Will On also develop tengu powers?!

Ever since getting rejected in junior high for her looks, Inukai-san has struggled to remake her appearance to become prettier. On the first day of high school, she was surprised when Amamiya, a popular boy photographer, took a snapshot of her when they met on their way to school. When Inukai-san saw the photo... she found the candid picture of herself to be surprisingly wonderful! And then Amamiya-kun told her, "Inukai-san looks very cute when she's trying so hard," and suddenly kissed her out of the blue—!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

155160.description:
If a person's name is written on the walls of the cursed manor, that person will die – and the one who wrote it will lose something precious to him. Or so goes the urban legend.

One day, a group of boys are greeted by a grisly sight in their secret hideout: A man whose last words were of a “cursed manor”… a place that will send the boys' lives spiraling into madness.

A horror story of urban legends and haunted mansions, brought to you by the tag team behind Monkey Peak!

(Source: Nihonbungeisha, translated)

155161.description: It's about a guy who constantly feels bored with his life, is two-timing two OLs at his work, but can't seem to truly fall for anyone. Then when he finally finds someone that might be "the one", she turns out to be a ton of trouble!

155162.description:
Fu Anyang, born into happiness as a spoiled rich kid, died when his sister fled her marriage. Forced to cross-dress to replace her on a blind date, he didn't expect Ji Yuan to be so hard to deal with. With this, Fu Anyang's one-sided feud began. As they grew closer, his impression of Ji Yuan started to change as he discovered Ji Yuan was a man with a passionate and sincere heart beneath the shackles of solitude...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

155163.description:
Only the Slayer can save the world.

Long ago, vampires were created by the devil as destroyers of humanity. Now a vampire is after something but can disguise itself like anyone. What happens when an experienced and blood-crazed vampire gets loose in the city and no one is there to stop it?

(Source: Manta)

155164.description:
One kiss is all it takes.

“Have you kissed someone yet?” Yoona is constantly pestered by her parents to hurry up and kiss a boy. Why? Because students who don’t kiss someone before they turn 17 go crazy every time it rains! Yoona doesn’t want to wind up like the others at her school. Will she find someone to kiss in time?

(Source: Manta)

155165.description:
To make sure her webtoon is perfect, author Baek Mireu starts working as a maid at the Sophist Hotel to help inspire her story, but ends up in trouble that could make her lose her job. Thankfully, the good-looking and wealthy hotel president Kang Hyuk is there to save her, but there's a catch—she must agree to a contractual relationship to help get his marriage-crazed mother off his back. But even though the relationship is fake, Hyuk slowly finds that his feelings for Mireu might be real.

(Source: Tapas)

155166.description:
A detective moves in with a bombmaker. After his divorce and demotion, Detective Yoon thinks life can't possibly get worse. That is, until his sister asks him to move in with her fiancé Junggu, a former bombmaker trying to get a fresh start. But just as the two misfits become flatmates, Junggu's past comes to haunt him with a bang.

(Source: Manta)

155167.description:
Chiaki was an ordinary high school girl who loved to cook, whose friend has just gone missing. She had made an extra bento, and she ended up giving it to her classmate Mutsuki instead, who ate it with great relish. One day, Chiaki was suddenly kidnapped by yakuza, and she found herself in a dire situation, when Mutsuki suddenly showed up and easily dispatched the gangsters. Yes, it turned out Mutsuki was actually a trained assassin! These two girls with opposite personalities will form a bond over food, in a new kind of friendship story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

155172.description:
A steamy take on the romance of Persephone and Hades brings the heat in this new romance manga!

In the Realm of the Gods, new goddess Persephone spends her days tending to her fields of flowers. Every new sprout comes at the cost of an old one withering and dying—which is how she meets the handsome but taciturn Hades, who visits to collect the dead. Persephone grieves for the death of her beloved plants, but Hades’s warmth and encouragement touch her heart. Persephone learns Hades is a victim of the Gods’ conspiracy, and she offers up her own body to save the Lord of the Underworld! Can their passion stand against all of Olympus?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

155186.description:
The Sukaku clan was a distinguished family of shamans, known for protecting mankind from divine beasts. The elder brother Mutsuki excelled at spiritual magic and the family had high hopes for his future. But his sister Uzuki lacked any sort of spiritual power. According to the family tradition, "If you are not shaman, then you are not a Sukaku." And so Uzuki was imprisoned in the house.

Mutsuki wanted freedom for his sister, but he realized that if that they could not escape, then they would have to fight, even if that means they have to overcome his own family.……! For the sake of his sister, the big brother will stand up in an unprecedented "home" revolution fantasy!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

155187.description:
Haruna, who had just lost her lover to suicide and was living in despair, was offered a job to become a "surrogate mother" to bear a child for an infertile couple... A masterpiece long-form story depicting the tragic and lonely love of a surrogate wife.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

155188.description:
A cosmic storm brought about a wave of mutations for all sorts of species. Giant, poisonous zombie monsters roamed the cities and roared as they waved battle-axes. Exotic beasts fought for territorial supremacy in the jungles. Humans were also awakened to a new ability known as the Cosmic Power... Zhou Zheng transmigrated into this post-apocalyptic world without any Cosmic Power. But he will take advantage of the powers offered by the rogue class in this game system to destroy the darkness and pursue ultimate power!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155189.description:
Meet Shisoya Toki, a quiet female teacher with a thing for “clothes”. Often seen as cold and unfriendly, her students call her the “unfortunate beautiful teacher”. But one day, while organizing supplies in the old school building, she finds a brand new pair of bloomers. Suddenly, her kinky curiosity about “clothes” goes wild.

Sometimes sexy, sometimes cute. Get ready for a wild ride full of seductive cosplay.

Your biggest fan since day one.

Hanul has always been Sanso's biggest supporter. But as Sanso gets closer to his dream of becoming a singer, they begin to drift apart. Four years later, Hanul has a boyfriend, and Sanso is in a popular idol group. Somehow, fate brings them together again. Will they share how they really feel this time?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 6 extras.

155192.description:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?

155197.description:
After passing out drunk on a cold night, I awake as a nameless young orphan girl. But she’s not just any girl, she’s a character from a novel I wrote in high school! Abused and sold at auction as a slave, I’m suddenly rescued by my father, Duke Henry Wensgrey, the story’s original villain. Far from the wicked character I created, he’s now a total fool for his daughter. But our relationship isn’t the only thing that’s changed, and I soon discover that this world isn’t anything like what I wrote!

(Source: Tapas)

155198.description:
Jae-In is a typical middle school girl obsessed with beauty and makeup and wishes to become a makeup artist. One day, she finds a mysterious lipstick by chance, which leads to the opening of a mysterious portal that warps her to a different dimension. When she wakes up the next moment, she realizes she has become a princess of a different world! Stuck in this mysterious world, will Jae-In be able to find a way out? Or better yet, will she be able to pursue her passion for beauty and live the life she could never live before?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

155203.description:
After parting ways nine years ago, Youngmin and his first love, Jihoon, have been reunited in the same homeroom class. There’s just one problem… that’s not really Jihoon. When the boys were young, a traumatic car accident landed Jihoon with an entirely new soul! To avoid suspicion, the fake Jihoon enlists his old friend’s help in fooling the rest of the world about his identity. This arrogant new guy is nothing like the old sweet, polite Jihoon… so why is Youngmin still getting butterflies?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.

155204.description:
Adelia Gerard had lost everything. The man she loved was dead, and her home was reduced to ashes. The person responsible for her misery? Her fiancé and crown prince of the empire, Elkarion Yearis. Heartbroken, Adelia vowed to knock him off his throne, but unbeknownst to her, the gears of fate had already begun to turn, sending her unexpectedly back in time. Now 19 again with her world back to normal, will Adelia be able to save her loved ones and bring down the crown prince once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

155205.description:
Cha Yoon and Kim Seo-Jin have known each other since childhood. And try as he might to avoid him, Seo-Jin always seems to end up being around Yoon, which only makes Yoon’s feelings for him grow fonder. So much so that Yoon has to steal kisses from Seo-Jin every night! But now through high school and beyond, what will become of their whirlwind romance?

155224.description:
Yun Si-U is a master of the fighting game "Bloodfist”. Even in real life, he can see a system that usually appears while playing games. Feeling bored with the game, Si-U turns towards actual combat, and tries to use his abilities to conquer his school, but is defeated by the snow leopard Hong Min-Jae. In order to compete with him again, Si-U joins the martial arts club "Lalapalooza"…

Kim Bok-Sil, is better known for having no success at love having gone with unrequited love for 20 years now. She's now on her 9th failure of unrequited love since graduating from high school. Bok-Sil, who vows that she will have a wonderful relationship when she becomes a college student, falls for her kind and handsome sunbae, Do-Yun.

The monster-slayer troops known as 'Sretu' no longer function as they used to, and humans have become the monsters' prey.

155228.description:
Kotaki Yumeji was just your typical high school student—until his childhood friend, Chieri Omine, transferred into his class, now standing at a jaw-dropping eight meters tall! As Chieri’s assigned helper, Yumeji finds himself navigating the ups and downs of school life in more ways than one. From giant-sized mishaps to tender moments, their unique relationship is full of heart-pounding surprises. But even with a height difference this extreme, who’s to say that romance is out of reach? Get ready for a romantic comedy that’s truly larger than life!

Piece of Cake is back with some satisfying conclusions in this short and sweet sequel, featuring your favorite characters! The three chapters each center around a specific subplot.

1st story: Narita Akari/Shibuya Naomi - After the deaths of her mother and uncle, Akari falls into a pit of despair despite the resounding success of her writing debut. Only one person can save her, but will he?

2nd story: Chiba and Ginko [the Origins of the Mebachiko Theatre Group] - Ginko's living with her heart on her sleeve, devoted to being a leading lady (one of two!) for Mebachiko. Life's all about having fun and laughing with your friends, isn't it? But when Chiba's suddenly enthralled by someone new, what will become of Ginko?

That's what Elaine realizes after a fatal accident slings her back to the past, where she wakes up as her powerless child self. All it takes is pretending that she's the daughter of her evil uncle the king to be captured by the enemy empire's tyrant. However, Elaine knows that she must struggle to prove her value as a hostage in order to survive. Or so she thinks... the last thing she expects is to take the emperor's heart hostage with her cuteness, of all things! But when he meets Yeon-Jo, the woman his donor was deeply in love with, and finds out that she has been living in despair, he begins developing ambivalent feelings towards her. In 10 days, the world will be destroyed by a meteor. To spend his remaining time as comfortably as possible, bad-luck magnet Masumi decides to visit the library of his alma mater and read as much as he wants until the end comes. But in this hellish world, he meets a devil there: the one man from his past that he never wanted to see again, Ritsu. And if things weren't bad enough, Ritsu has a favor to ask, a favor that Masumi could never have expected--

Marukido Maki weaves an eccentric tale of human connection in a world on the brink of destruction in this emotional journey that will take its readers on a wild ride.

Come revisit the early days of their intimacy, including their sweet, tender, and hot first experiences together…

(Source: Webnovel)

Wei Xi is a Z-list idol. One day he's informed that he won't live past the age of thirty, and his life becomes entangled with handsome university professor, Pei Fengxin.

The cold virtual life body Tong Heguang is always cracking small jokes in his daily life. He happened upon the lazy e-sports genius Soda, and the two of them became acquainted with the gentle and mysterious Baiju. Three teenagers with distinct personalities are aspiring to be idols. On the road, how do you go from strange and alienated to walking side by side, and what kind of sparks will collide?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

155393.description:
In her past life, before a plane crash, she was a genius in both medicine and poison. In this life, she is the legitimate daughter of a noble family whose fiancé has been snatched by her illegitimate sister.

Right after entering her new life, she finds herself already infected with a serious case of body odor. The younger sisters of the original host's body scorn her, and she has found out that the original host died because she hit her head against the railing when her fiancé slapped her. Now that she has replaced the previous host, she will not allow these despicable villains to continue opressing her.

Why does the Cold-faced Prince, known as the War King of Hell, seem so different from the rumors? Regardless, whoever that insults her, frames her, or tries to assassinate her must die!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

155394.description:

What starts as a simple act of kindness quickly escalates into a series of unexpected events, leading to an unusual cohabitation. As Jiang Yutang gets closer to the seemingly perfect Yu Sinian, he begins to question the superstar’s true intentions. Is Yu Sinian genuinely altruistic, or does he have a hidden agenda?

(Source: Webnovel)

In order to protect the secret technique, the war demon Tang Xiao sealed the it with a secret spell and scattered it throughout the world...

Mu Xiaolou, a servant born with an ugly birthmark, and Tang Yinjiu, the mysterious new guest at the villa, find themselves entwined by fate because of the secret spell.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated and edited)

155396.description:
What kind of secret love is going on in the infirmary today!?

A caring class president and a delinquent who skips class.
A kind intern teacher and a devoted member of the school infirmary committee.
A serious student council president and her devilish vice president.
The ace of the basketball team and her childhood friend, the manager.
The story takes place in the infirmary of a high school for girls,
Featuring girls who fall deeply in love with each other with all their heart, a sensational adolescent love story!

(Source: MF Comics Flapper Series, translated)

155398.description:
The "jochuu" (maid) used to be a major occupation for Japanese women, and they were a part of everyday life. This is the story of a 14-year-old girl, Hana Nonaka, who worked as a maid for a translator, Reiko Hasumi, in the early Showa period when such maids were the most common.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

title.native: うちのちいさな女中さん

155400.description: Satoshi looks different from all the kids in school—blond hair, blue eyes. His favorite sport is different as well: squash. Though he'd trained alone for the longest time, Yuuki, a boy with social anxiety, suddenly joins the squash club. Why squash? Because when you're both facing the same wall, you're not looking anyone in the eyes—and you have someone on your side.

155403.description:
After the death of her beloved grandmother, Chika became involved in a series of mysterious incidents. She was also being followed by a mysterious man named Sei. It seems that this man might know the reason why strange things have happened to Chika...? At first, Sei offered some kind words to Senka, who was distressed by the supernatural events. However, right after that, he suddenly and unexpectedly made a surprise attack and kidnapped Chika...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

155404.description:
Hajime Hime, the leader of the Pussycats gang, tried to show his friends how to pick up girls by talking to a pony-tailed high school girl in a sailor suit uniform. But to his surprise, he got turned down. Despite the pain of rejection, Hajime fell in love at first sight, and with the help of his friends, he set out to find that girl. He managed to find her, but it turned out that she was a young lady known for her fighting skill...?

(Source: BookWalker, translated)

This is the fifth iteration of the Mugen Shinshi franchise.

155414.description:
In Mizusawa Village, a mountain village in Kokura, Kitakyushu, there was an opposition movement against the construction of a dam. Ayu, who visited Mizusawa Village when she was in college and was fascinated by the place, wanted to do something to help, so she quits her job and took action... This is a coming-of-age comic filled with humanity, sex, tears, and laughter, featuring Hatada, a city councilor who boldly claims that he will revive Mizusawa Village with the compensation money from the dam construction, a mysterious man named Seito, and Ryuko, a childhood friend who married into Mizusawa Village. A masterpiece in the world Hatanaka-sensei!

(Source: eBookJapan, translated)

155415.description:
Sora, a plain girl who longed to be a magical girl, was scouted by the lady-boss of an evil army! With two handsome henchmen in tow, the hidden talent of a bad girl awakens...!

155416.description:
Towa and Yamato are twins with very different personalities. Yamato is loud, outgoing, and regularly gets into fights, while Towa is quiet, studious, and always suffering the after effects of Yamato's actions because he's always being mistaken for his brother.

On his way home from school one day, Towa was getting beaten up by the school gang who had mistaken him for Yamato, when he met Mitsuru, a mysterious delinquent. For some reason, Mitsuru can tell the twins apart...

155417.description:
Seo Hyunji was just an ordinary office worker when she died and was reborn as Lady Abella Travis, the daughter of a wealthy noble family. Sadly, in this life, she has horrid in-laws, a playboy husband, and ultimately ends up dying tragically with no way of getting revenge. Reborn as Abella again, she vows that this time, things will be different. She calls off her wedding and decides to fulfill her fantasy of opening a dessert cafe. Will she finally have the sweet life she always dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas)

155420.description:
As the heir to the Yooshin corporation, Yoo Taehyuk is living his best life. However, everything changes when he’s informed that the dragon, the patron deity of the Yoo family, wants to forsake them to be with his mate. When his sister is asked to take the fall for the family and announce herself as the dragon’s mate, Taehyuk steps up instead. He agrees to meet the dragon in the hopes that he can convince him to stay. But will Taehyuk succeed in slithering into the impervious dragon’s good graces or get under his scales?

(Source: Lezhin US)

155421.description:
My grandfather and grandmother killed my mother behind my father’s back before I was ten. On the seventh day after her burial, her body vanished from her coffin, and a living ghost showed up. After that, my grandfather fell ill, and terrifying corpses appeared in the deserted graveyard. My mother’s death brought endless trouble to my family…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

155422.description:
It seems a little unlucky!? However, this is a heartfelt and heartwarming story about a dog who lives in its own way.

The nature of happiness is that if you think you are happy, you are.

Capybara-san lives with his friends in the Midorino Plains.
He loves going to hot springs, eating grass, and sleeping soundly.

(Source: TRYWORKS, translated)

155424.description:
La forêt is an unpopular and poorly managed French restaurant which nobody cares about. Genius chefs plummeted overnight, and ace food critics suddenly disappeared one day. "We must always guard this important restaurant!" However, in La forêt, it seems that every cook has secrets and ghosts of different appearances suddenly appeared. Can we protect this beloved restaurant until the very end before it closes?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

155427.description:
In a strange twist of fate, Jing Qiu, a teenager living on an alternate Earth full of magical creatures, picked up a sticky slime. To his surprise, the little slime could transform into an adorable little boy, and also possessed an unbelievable identity!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155429.description: A boy from an alien planet learns that he is not from there. He travels to Earth for an "immigration project", and must learn to live among humans in the scariest place on Earth: Seoul, Korea.

155432.description:
Kasumi is dedicated to her career, and as a result of her hard work, she gets transferred to her company's head office in New York! She can't help feeling a little melancholy, though... Just like her friends, Kasumi wants to find love. However, she may find it sooner than expected! After falling in love with a beautiful painting, Kasumi discovers that the artist is Dylan, a young, attractive half-Japanese guy. She's instantly smitten, but his teasing strokes aren't confined to the canvas... Has Kasumi actually found her one true love?

(Source: Renta!)

155433.description:
"Look, you're dripping, does it feel that good?"His fingers crept past the seam of my panties and inside... Oh no, I'm gonna cum!!I, Chisa, was completely unacquainted with the ways of love until, one day, I fell in love at the first sight of the super-popular flower shop clerk, Hagiya. He's as beautiful as any princely character out of a girls' comic, and my feelings welled up until I confessed them to him, and... "If you want to know me that badly, then I'll show you."He brought his lips close to mine, and a hand up my skirt... Agh... No, his fingers... So rough...! Hagiya's always so gentle, how could he be this perverted and harsh...!?

155434.description:
By a fluke, trainee teacher, Shen Yitong, became the temporary assistant of her senior whom she is in fond of. While being close to her is the only thing she had hoped for, she accidentally offended the mogul of the entertainment industry! What? That hooligan dare lay his filthy eyes on her? To protect my heart's devotion, don't blame me when I get onto ya!

(Source: Webnovel)

155437.description:
He is a dark beast worthy of his name who’ll do anything for money. This is what Isabella Barret is told about Lion Black, the man she must marry while in disguise as his actual fiancée, Violet Lancaster. As dangerous as this gamble is, if Isabella manages to fool Lion until their one-year marriage contract is over, she’ll be freed of yet another contract that has kept her shackled for the past five years. But to Isabella’s surprise, she isn’t the only one putting up a fake act in the relationship, as Lion’s heart might not be as cruel as his reputation suggests. And what’s more, the longer Isabella looks at him, the more she begins to see in him a precious old friend who presumably died years ago…

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Secret Bride of the White Lion
It's a secret and it's a flower
白い獅子の秘められた花嫁

155438.description:
After falling into a river to elude her attackers, the mercenary Ilian Heinrich wakes up a decade prior as Haven Winter, a 12-year-old noble burdened with debt and a family to look after. Determined to protect them, Haven uses her past memories to be hired by the young Duke Julius Al Richard, the one person she cared for as Ilian. Unfortunately, prickly Julius isn't going to make her job easy. With such a difficult boss, will Haven live up to her name and secure a safe future for her loved ones?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.
synonyms: あなたの死を捧げる時
ถึงเวลามอบความตายของคุณ

155439.description:
Many people imagine living the life of a hero/heroine within their favorite fantasy novels. However, what if you wake up in the body of the main villain/villainess instead?

Our main character goes through a seemingly fatal air crash and wakes up in the body of Letisha de Arcadia, the main villainess within her favorite fantasy novel. What's even worse is that she already knows how this story is going to end: Letisha's beheading after her identity as a fake princess gets revealed. To evade her tragic fate, our character must continue living as a fake princess while attempting to forge an amicable relationship with the original protagonists of the novel, Amelita and Sighard.

This is a story of survival.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: にせもの王女の生き残り方

155440.description:
When country boy Yewang enrolls at the prestigious Yeonghwa Academy to follow his favorite idol Jena Lee, he expects a life of glitz and glamor among Korea’s future elite. But he’s in for a rude awakening when he finds himself at the very bottom of the social ladder upon his arrival and targeted by the school bullies. Not only that, bullying seems to be normalized at Yeonghwa Academy, with victims designated as “Loafs”, who are essentially free targets. Finding allies along the way, Yewang sets out to fight back against his bullies and the school’s strict hierarchy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

155441.description:
Eiji is a high school student who lives with his unsuccessful novelist father. He's a shy, poor otaku, but he's a thoughtful boy who never forgets what his late mother taught him about the importance of compassion for others. What Eiji also admires is Aoi, the daughter of the president of a large company. However, Eiji couldn't even bear to look at her, given the huge disparity between them. One day, after school, Aoi greets Eiji when he returns home. Eiji is surprised when Aoi says something astonishing...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: I'm A Shy and Poor Otaku but This Beautiful Rich Young Lady is Obsessed with Me

155442.description:
After overcoming a miserable life, she entered the university full of excitement. Da-Bom, who had countless dreams and desires about university, encountered a villain on her very first day... And it's somewhat awkward from the start!

"Is my campus life going to be okay?!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

155443.description:
It's hard to live as a grade-schooler. Even more so when you get a new mom.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

155444.description:
"Did he die because of me?"

Animal behaviorist Hyunwoo's love for penguins drives him all the way over to Antarctica. Once there, however, he encounters a series of mishaps and soon discovers that surviving in the harsh cold is no easy feat. Will Hyunwoo be able to conduct his research and return to Korea in one piece?

(Source: Manta)

155445.description:
Daguerreotype, the first photographic technique using mercury.
—On the back of the silvered glass plate, which is polished like a mirror.
The portrait of the subject appears as if it is shimmering, reproduced with astonishing precision, down to the smallest hair.
Perhaps the magical power of the noble metal "silver" also helped.
People at that time were awed and amazed by these beautiful and fragile silver photographs.
The encounter between two brothers and the traveling Daguerreotype photographer.
A secret agreement between the two submerged in mercury film...
A story of those who lie at the bottom of the liquid mirror of memory.

(Source: Gettosha, translated)
synonyms: The widow of fisherman can't stop knitting

155446.description:
Hana, who works in a design office, moves into the same apartment as her senior colleague, whom she admires... Hana hopes that will improve her relationship with her senior. But when she wakes up in her new room on her first day, she finds a strange man sleeping in her bed... He seems to be the manager of the apartment...

A love story that begins with a kiss, in an apartment where dreams bloom.

(Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

3. Harukaze ni Kiita Ohanashi (春風にきいたお話)

155448.description:
Haruka is mysteriously reincarnated as Layna, the villainess daughter of a Duke in her favorite otome game. As soon as that happens, a game event begins where Layna's supposed to bully the game's heroine. But if Layna bullies her, she's sure to follow the game's path to her eventual doom! This is no time to be a villainess! One must enjoy life to the fullest, right?! Well, it seems she's chosen to fight for her happiness, but the heroine and the romance options in the game keep making her life an absolute mess!

(Source: Alpha Manga)

155449.description:
Haruka unexpectedly transmigrates into the body of Reina, the villainess of an otome game.

As soon as she transmigrates, an event in which the villainess bullies the heroine starts. If she bullies the heroine like in the game, the only ending that awaited Reina will be one of destruction. This isn’t the time to be acting like a villainess, I want to enjoy my life! Determined to enjoy the otherworldly life to the fullest, Raina forgets about the game scenario and stays busy playing with her friends. But the heroine and the game’s love interests keep getting in her way?!

Dreaming of a carefree life, the villainess Raina pushes forward in this world of turmoil!

(Source: Alphaspolis, translated)

title.native: 悪役令嬢はヒロインを虐めている場合ではない

155450.description:
You never know what today holds!

100-year-old writer Jin-Hee was ready to leave her life behind. But in a world of new technology and higher life expectancies, that’s no longer the case. Together with her robot caretaker M.U. and her upbeat neighbor Bae-Gun, can Jin-Hee rediscover the simple joys that make life worth living?

(Source: Manta, edited)

155451.description:
“Will you save us? YES or NO?”

In standard dating sim style, “Anise” was summoned as a Saint into the world of “Garden of Salvation”. However, Hime, another girl who was also summoned alongside her, stole the title of “Saint” for herself! Without being allowed to use the “healing magic” that she had learned, Anise was exiled to a remote village. If things stick to the script, a general from the neighboring kingdom of Farglow will die before long and Hime will reign supreme as the Saint in the bad ending. For Anise, that means death. In order to find her own path for survival, she decides to save the general and rewrite the story, but…

(Source: MangaUP!)

title.native: 聖女のはずが、どうやら乗っ取られました
title.romaji: Seijo no Hazu ga, Douyara Nottoraremashita

155453.description:
A rich little heiress runs away from home and meets a swordswoman in seclusion deep in the mountains. What sort of story will unfold between the two of them? (Probably a simple and sweet little love story)

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155454.description:
Martin Scofield’s a lone werewolf who was born a highly breedable “snow.” To avoid being used, he spent years on the run, taking odd jobs to survive. On the other hand, Daniel Sinclair was lovingly raised by two phantom vampires until a certain hunter killed them in cold blood and left him orphaned. When the two unknowingly reunite centuries later, Martin’s mission to avoid love and Daniel’s mission to avenge the only love he knew get sidelined as something much deeper develops between them.

(Source: Tapas)

155455.description:
Homura-sensei is the frail biology teacher in his track-suit and white lab coat. Hasumi-san is a new home economics teacher, returning to her alma mater to be with him. Their social positions may have changed, but their feelings remain the same. The sweet, awkward romance between them continues, in this new series depicting their love story as adults!

(Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

Note: Sekaneko started publishing this manga on her blog on September 14, 2021. On September 2022, the manga got licensed by Kadokawa.

155456.description:
“Why are you being so nice to a girl like me… It's kinda weird!!” An older salaryman, a soccer club ace, and a childhood friend… It's handsome sweet boys vs cynical introverted girls, in a new story collection that will make you laugh and make your heart flutter.

2. Osananajimi Renai Ron (幼馴染恋愛論; The childhood friends' dispute)
3. Tadashii Heroine no Tsutomekata (正しいヒロインの務め方; How to be a proper heroine)
4. Baito Senshi wa Shizuka ni Kasegitai (バイト戦士は静かに稼ぎたい; The part-time worker wants to earn money)

A Series of Cold Side Characters
Baito Senshi wa Shizuka ni Kasegitai

title.romaji: Shiotaiou na Watashi ga Amayaka Sareteimasu

155457.description:
With both my parents passing away early on, I've spent my days working to support my younger brothers and sisters. One of the few things that helped me through this was fawning over my favorite character from a mobile game, and my boss, who happens to be the handsome and talented producer that created said game. But, one day he found out about my secret part-time job. If I'm fired, I can't pay the bills. If I can't pay the bills, we'll be out on the street...!!! But instead of exposing me, he makes me an offer. The deal? Become his housekeeper. I didn't think that would include putting him to bed though...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

155458.description:
Shin, a serial murderer, has shaken the entire nation of South Korea to its core. Ji-Hu Seo, who lost his father to Shin’s evil deeds, meets another victim: Du-Seok Kim, a former detective who also had his family murdered by Shin. Du-Seok vows to turn Ji-Hu into a human weapon to exact revenge on Shin -- in prison, with his bare hands.

“Korea has not implemented the death penalty since 1997. With no one else upholding justice, what other choice is there?”

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: เด็กหนุ่มผู้ลงทัณฑ์

155459.description:
After losing her parents at an early age, noble lady Elissa Lohengrin is brought into the powerful House Rubelin by the duke so that she can marry his grandson, Richard. However, having read this story in her past life, Elissa knows Richard is destined to murder her! To avoid this, Elissa makes a deal with Richard to divorce when they become adults. But as she plans for her future single life, Richard's feelings begin to grow, and a whirlwind of events begins that pulls Elissa closer to danger.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes: Chapter count includes 10 side stories
synonyms: I Am Trying to Divorce My Villainous Husband, but We Have a Child

意外懷上反派丈夫的孩子

155460.description:
Goyoh Rubiet did everything in her power to avoid an arranged marriage with the power-hungry Marquess Anthe Betelgeuse. Instead, Goyoh's sister is forced to marry him, but it's not long before Goyoh learns that her sister has been murdered by the marquess. Soon after, as she's struggling with guilt, Goyoh wakes up as a past version of herself. This time around, Goyoh is determined to accept her arranged marriage to save her sister. But is there any way she can avoid meeting the same grisly fate?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Marriage B: Wed to the Enemy

155461.description:
After Meil von Biseart has an ominous dream that Princess Riella destroys her home upon being rejected by the emperor of the Helberne Empire, she runs after Riella to stop her from joining the selection for the next empress. In the midst of her efforts, she meets a mysterious masked man in the palace garden who seems to know an awful lot about the emperor. As she uses this new intel for her plan, Meil begins to draw some unexpected attention... At this rate, her dream might come true!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: วิ่งสิ เมล

155462.description:
Caught up in her parents’ political scheme, Yurania is forced to lose her sight and voice in order to marry Duke Casius Euclid and betray him. After being imprisoned for her treachery and despised by all, she makes one dying wish to turn back time and freely live her own life. When Yurania miraculously awakens mere days before the betrayal, she seizes the opportunity to right everything... only to discover that her past relationships and all that she had known weren't what they seemed.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Somehow, My Tyrant Husband Has Became Cautious
My Tyrant's Husband Somehow Became Cautious

155463.description:
Newcomer Ox-Head has just arrived in the underworld, only to find out that the King of Hell is a kawaii minor, Old Lady Meng is a sexy onee-san, and he's going to be hunting souls with the cold and handsome senpai Horse-Face... Ready? Let's go into this funny and interesting underworld!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155464.description:
When an accident shows Ellie what bullying the male lead, Damian, would do to her in the future, she tries to stay away from him at all costs. But after seeing everyone else mistreat the poor boy, she decides to protect him until he meets Duke Schuetz, his future adoptive father. However, there's one thing Ellie doesn't expect when she helps them reunite: the duke's offer to bring her with them as his daughter-in-law! How will this new plot twist change her fate and the course of the story?

(Source: Tapas)

155465.description:
Ian is seemingly the perfect student – kind, trustworthy, and handsome to boot, he became known as “the Angel of Christmas” thanks to an innocent act of kindness from when he was a child. So when Yugun returns to school after an extended sick leave, no one is surprised when Ian is there to help him get through the day. Thanks to Ian’s cherubic persona, Yugun thinks he can trust him - that is, until he overhears a conversation between the boy and his mother that reveals it was all a plan to maintain Ian’s image. Incensed at the betrayal, Yugun confronts Ian and threatens to reveal his true colors to everyone. However, Ian’s unexpected response confuses Yugun even more: “Go ahead. But whatever happens after is not my responsibility.” After all, who could hate the supposed “Angel of Christmas?” Will the two remain like oil and water? Or will they learn to blend together to create something more beautiful than either of them could have ever imagined?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

155466.description:
Shigeaki Yashiro is proud to be a loner, doing his own thing without getting involved with others. From studying alone in a karaoke room to relaxing by himself in open-air hot springs, Yashiro is an expert in finding the perks of doing things solo. But his solitary existence begins to unravel when Kanon Hanamizawa, one of the popular girls at school, asks him to teach her his ways. She knows just how exhausting keeping up with all the latest trends can be, especially since she's afraid to talk about her own uncool hobbies. Yashiro becomes Hanamizawa's reluctant teacher, but soon finds himself tangled in the antics of his apprentice's popular friends. A lone wolf could learn some new tricks from social butterflies!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 八城くんのおひとり様講座

155467.description:
Shigeaki Yashiro’s saga as an expert loner continues when the students of Iikanyama High take a school trip to Kamakura. Yashiro wants nothing more than to spend some time alone with his girlfriend, but his plan begins to fall apart when their popular friends ask the couple to join in on some group fun instead. How will these wildly different personalities get along? Enjoy these stories of the past and the future, from the perspectives of loners and cool kids alike.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

In a world with only the sky and the sea, there exist two opposing tribes. After Iona from the winged sky tribe meets Helen from the scaled water tribe by happenstance at the water's edge, a deep bond starts to form between the two.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155469.description:
Hong Jin-Ju and Ji Su-Jeong couldn't be any more different. Jin-Ju is bubbly, popular, and more interested in hanging out with friends and chasing women than worrying about school. On the other hand, Su-Jeong is quiet and reserved, relying on her good grades to earn her scholarship money to afford her tuition. Contrary to her closed off and frigid appearance, Su-Jeong is secretly the model and muse for the lingerie company, “Goodnight Cinderella.” Jin-Ju is drawn to the mysterious nature of Su-Jeong and wants to get to know her better, meanwhile Su-Jeong is keen to stay away and protect her secrets. Watch as the juicy drama unfolds on campus.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

155471.description:
Bibi is a bubbly girl who's deeply obsessed with Peter, the cutest boy at her high school. So when she sees a random girl talking to him, Bibi invites her to a sleepover with malicious intent... only to have a surprisingly nice time! That's how she makes friends with Amy, a shy and sweet girl who agrees to help Bibi get with Peter. But as they cook up all sorts of love schemes to win Peter over, Amy's place in Bibi's heart grows bigger and bigger by the day...

(Source: Tappytoon)

155473.description:
Iroha Hodumi feels the walls coming in on her as the handsome model she manages at her talent agency job starts singing her praises.Never particularly sought after by men, Iroha has been painted as a hard worker who lectures those around her. However, when Asuka, the model she's in charge of, sees her crying one day, one thing leads to another, and they end up in bed together. After being drilled by her boss that inappropriate relationships with clients are strictly prohibited, how is she going to explain how she ended up in bed with Asuka...!?

Iroha is overwhelmed at being the subject of this younger man's aggressive advances! A scandalous love story between a hardworking manager and a handsome model.

(Source: Renta!)

Himejima-kun, a first-year high school boy, has an unrequited crush on his classmate Hoshimiya-san! However, Himejima-kun is very worried about how "Hoshimiya-san is much taller"... A frustratingly cute classic romantic comedy about "height differences"!!

During a turbulent period of the Republic of China, there's a young man as beautiful as a girl, and a young master who looks stable but is actually rebellious. Gender, class, and the turbulent state of the country... Can they really overcome all the obstacles and live happily ever after?

Ruan Lingxing and Ruan Lingyue are beautiful twin sisters who live in the picturesque Wushan Village. Because the family is poor and their father is sick, the elder sister has to work from morning to night, but the younger sister just wants to live off of others' hard work.

One day, the elder sister Lingxing rescues a handsome young master. Later, the man's family come to propose marriage, but the younger sister has a wicked thought...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Oh My God, look at that butt!

Stretch it, squish it, and get deep inside it– Misa Wasabi's newest book is full of hourglass figures looking for some bottomfeeders who want nothing more than to feast! What will you do if a suit with a briefcase full of money presents himself in front of you? For Hanjun Park, a high schooler beaten down to the ground in an alley, the answer has been set in stone for a while: be true to his heart once more, unleash those simmering knuckles, and beat the sh*t out of anyone standing on his way to his revenge. Suit, make it rain. It’s time to wash away some bad blood.

Explosive laughter, tragedy, and love. The first collection of works by Kazuya Konomoto, a genius who moves freely between shocking and humor.

155485.description:
When the war between the aboveground and underground ended, humanity was joined by so-called "dungeon babies," those gifted with supernatural abilities and an obsession with the labyrinths below ground. Despite being a dungeon baby, Kim Jin-U suppressed his instincts, choosing to live an ordinary life as a guide and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong and he somehow ends up becoming the new owner of a labyrinth, he discovers that he cannot ignore his instincts forever...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

155487.description:
Once known as Mr. Perfect, MMA legend Sanghyuk Kang dies undefeated, only to be reborn as a nine year old young master in Murim. In a world without rules, where only strength decides life or death, he aims to become champion again.

(Source: Toomics)

155488.description:
Kim Moojin's job was to support the supernatural beings known as "vagrants" on missions, cleaning up the messes they leave behind. Then one day, he is killed in a fight between vagrants, but to his surprise, he wakes up in the year 2002, the peak of his youth! Though excited to relive the good years, he finds out that, unfortunately, he's been cursed by a demon! Now, the only way for Moojin to cure himself is by working with the ones he hoped to avoid the most... the vagrants.

(Source: Tapas)

155490.description:
In the smash hit game, [Demon War 3], there are ‘extras’ that die every day in all sorts of ways. But despite not contributing the slightest bit to the game, an extra named Evan D. Shelden has a death scene with exclusive computer graphics that stole the love of the production team! Damn it, isn’t that the name I received when I was reincarnated into this game world? I, someone who isn’t the main character and an extra who has too many deaths to count, must survive at all costs!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The manga adaptation of the award-winning light novel! Eden is a place of perfection, protected from outside harm by the silver dragon. In this idyllic land, the dragon raises a human girl found on the island's shores as his own. But when the dragon's life is mercilessly snuffed out by human machinations, the girl must choose whether to heed his dying wish and stay the course of righteousness…or walk a path of vengeance.

(Source: Yen Press)

Tasuku Nakamura, who was thrown into the sea in a marine accident and tried to help his best friend, ended his short life of 25 years. Formerly a mediocre office worker, when he opened his eyes, he was in the form of a six-year-old baron's daughter, Sophie Linier. Rei Takaoki is a boy who loves brass music, with a father who is a professional trumpet player. However, he suffers from asthma, which prevented him from becoming a trumpet player himself. He gave up on his dream and went to a high school that does not have a band. There, he meets Mizune Hoshino, a free trumpet player, and the leader of the school's newly formed brass band. She recognizes Rei's "love for brass" and invites him to join the club...

Because of her overly expressive emotions, everyone thinks that Mazumi is a flirt. Keita Midorikawa, who learned that the school festival was canceled due to corona, called on everyone in the class to dance anyway. With so many things going against them, such as no school, no social gatherings, and no place to practice, will they all be able to dance together?

Maruru lived a pampered life till one day, he ran after a flock of sparrows and couldn’t find his way back home. He encounters Hachi, a tough stray, who says he doesn’t need a spoiled house cat on his territory and chases him away. One night, stuck with the cleanup after a long evening of karaoke with colleagues, he decides to sing one more song. Little does he know that the ghost of the wild-child rock star Jihyeok Han has been waiting, hoping to find the perfect vessel for his superstar aura…

Chased by slavers, Charuelle jumps into a random passing carriage as her last hope. The owner of the carriage, with his bewitching face and muscular body, was Modestro, the prince of the kingdom! Ever since she was young, Sana has been made fun of for being taller than her peers. Fortunately, most people don’t make mean comments about her appearance anymore… most. Kouhei, a regular customer at her café, knows exactly how to make her tick. But Sana knows how to defend herself now: fight fire with fire! For some reason, Kouhei unlocks a comfort in Sana that lets her let loose. Maybe he can unlock even more feelings in Sana…?

When Hinagishi - a devoted, responsible head teacher - ends up with Yashiki as his assistant, conflict is inevitable.

(Source: Tapas)

Lacking interest in fashion and boys, she's often told that she doesn't have a single drop of femininity in her. One day, while searching for a part-time job, she finds posting looking for a pet-sitter! She applies for the position right away, but the job is apparently in a luxury high-rise apartment?! And her employer is the former number-one male host in town?! What's more, Akane's best friend wasted a lot of money on that particular host, so she subconsciously holds a grudge against him. However, as she works and and spends time with him, she finds out about his love for dogs and his kind-hearted side, and her bad impression of him changes bit by bit.

Despite having worn pants almost her entire life, she tries on a skirt for once, and as her feelings for him change, Akane herself begins to change as well. What will become of the relationship between a dog-loving tomboy and the former No. 1 male host...?!

The God of Time – Khronos – gave Zhang Heng an incredible gift.

Time freezes at the end of the day for everyone except Zhang Heng, who gains an additional 24 hours. In exchange, Zhang Heng must act as the agent for the God of Time and participate in a dangerous game each month: Deserted Island Survival [Mission Objective: Survive for 40 days], Tokyo Drift [Mission Objective: Win the underground street racing championship], and so on…

As Zhang Heng stacks up victory after victory, he is also getting closer to the truth of this world.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

"Don't tell me I'm making you nervous just from doing this...?" Her body grows hotter with each touch. Even though it's her first time... her mind's totally blank! Having had a crush on Sagara, an older student from her high school, our heroine goes to his college to chase after him. She's put a lot of effort into changing her looks to start her new life, and then the unexpected happens! The person inviting her to join his extracurricular club is Sagara himself! And he's grown even more handsome in the two years she hasn't seen him... Still, rumors have been going around ever since high school that "he doesn't want girlfriends, only sex friends." In order to hide her true feelings from him, she acts like a playgirl, but his techniques are about to make her lose her mind...!

My name is Hinata Kunieda, and although I am short, I am still an adult-aged tutor. My problem is that my student, Mirai-chan, a fourth-grader, mistakes me for her classmate. But I'm sure I'll be able to effectively educate her with my grown-up charm and intelligence!

(Source: Dengeki DaiohG, translated)

155636.description:
Hojun possesses a unique ability to see a sign above people's heads - those that he is attracted to! When Hojun saw the sign above the famous Woosung's head, he feels the need to save this person. Romance between the two unlikely classmates blooms as they begin to get to know more about the other.

(Source: INKR)

155637.description:
Woo-Ri’s 5-year old poodle mix, Maru, has turned into a human — a 5-year old little girl, that is! Now Woo-Ri’s gone from pet owner to big sister, and it’s her job to keep Maru out of trouble. Human Maru has the same endless curiosity and playfulness of a puppy, but now she can walk into grocery stores, go to kindergarten, and check this out — hold things with her opposable thumbs. Being human rules!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: น้องสี่ขาเจ้ามารุ

155639.description:
"Just why do I have to possess someone who’s already possessed...?!"

I became the female lead in the novel "I Possessed the Villain’s Granddaughter", who is already possessed. But the truth is, she’s actually the villainess who will torment the real heroine. What do you mean I’ve become the villainess who will suffer terribly for harassing the heroine? I can’t believe it! My fate was sealed to become trash before I knew it! I can’t live like this!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

155640.description:
In the country of Adnogg, people known as dragon vets are responsible for treating the many different types of dragons that inhabit the land. After the death of her father, a military dragon vet, a girl named Luca decides to honor his final wishes by becoming a dragon vet herself. She enters Cogniel School of Dragon Studies, where she and her fellow trainees soon experience all the trials, tribulations…and occasional messes that come with treating creatures many times their size. The road to mastery may be long, but when there’s a dragon in need, the dragon vets answer the call!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

155641.description:
Natsuki's a coffee shop owner who took over his father's business. Akutsu, a regular customer, is a real estate businessman in charge of a redevelopment plan that involves evicting businesses in Natsuki's shopping district. They become adversaries as negotiations continue with the shopping arcade, which explains Natsuki's aloofness toward Akutsu in their daily exchanges.

But, one day, they become secretly involved in a way Natsuki never imagined. Akutsu spots Natsuki outside a bar catering to men and notices his hesitation to take the first step. Who would have guessed that he would suggest experimenting with him?

So begins a bittersweet, mature game of love between a confident realtor and a coffee shop proprietor who has no experience with relationships.

(Source: Renta!)

155642.description:
Anise is an inquisitive girl who loves books and reading about about plants. However, she lives a quiet life, thinking that she would marry a local boy and spend the rest of her life with him, never leaving her village. Then one day, a mysterious disease breaks out in the village. In order to save her mother and the villagers from the disease, Anise sets off in search of a legendary medicinal herb called "amakoikusa." Based on a rumor that the herb is found where cave bees live, Anise goes to a dungeon in an old castle. There, she meets Wolfe, a lone, wounded swordsman. After helping to heal him, they begin to work together to explore the dungeon, but Wolfe seems to have another goal in mind.

It turns out the dungeon they are exploring is no ordinary dungeon, but one filled with lewd traps…? As he saves Anise from the tentacles, slimes, and other erotically… stimulating hazards, even the stubborn Wolfe's heart begins to grow hot with uncontrollable passion, and the two begin to play with each other to relieve the sexual tension.

Once upon a time there was an innocent and straightforward little Aries girl.

After being targeted by a black-bellied Leo boy who used food to lure her, she couldn't resist the Leo boy at all!

The boy said : "I'm determined to be there whenever you need me. I'll be with you wherever you eat and drink, and I'll even finish all the vegetables you hate. I'll do my best to make you happy, so just be with me."

Camping is seeing a great renaissance in popularity! You want to try it yourself, but… what do you need to go camping? How do you find a good spot? What food can you make while camping that's tasty and easy? What should you wear, and what should you do once you're there? How do you put up a tarp? Do you have to wash the tent every time?

Until Jiang Shu attacked Tianyuan Mountain and his sect, which led to his death...

A hundred years later, Ye Zigui was brought back to life through forbidden methods. In order to find his main body, he had no choice but to sneak into the lair of the demon lord, Jiang Shu.

Tired of his boss picking on him at any given opportunity, Kasey resigns from his job to go on a backpacking trip. He meets Dave, who from the very start is cold and rude towards him. As the two get closer, Kasey grows more and more attracted to Dave. But Kasey wasn’t supposed to stay in one place for long. What will happen to his backpacking trip? What will happen to them?

155666.description:

I, Meng Fanjun, spent all my time telling other people’s fortunes, but unexpectedly overlooked my own luck in love?! A hospital visit brings to me a chance encounter with a doctor who absolutely piques my interest! His gentle heart hides under an icy demeanor.

"Doctor Tao, I did a divination reading: you’re missing Jun in your life. Not Jun as in just any “gentleman” out there, but Jun as in me, Meng Fanjun!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

155667.description:
Once a promising swimmer, Youngwan was forced to abandon his passion when a traumatic incident unleashed an overwhelming aquaphobia. Now, Youngwan is enjoying ordinary college life, taking up studies as an athletic major, and shooting hoops with friends as a hobby. One day, Sunwoo, a brilliant pianist with secrets of his own, approaches Youngwan and asks an unusual favor. “Can I watch you play basketball tomorrow?” Will this budding new friendship help heal the scars of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

155671.description:

155672.description:
Ella Walker looks back on her life atop a guillotine. She was forced to cancel her engagement with Prince Gil in favor of her stepsister Isabella and demoted to rule a desolate Hinterland. Then, the resulting riot leads to Ella getting executed. But after the execution, she somehow ends up reincarnated ten years into the past. Having been given a chance to do it all over again, Ella is determined to live her new life freely, without being tied down. She gives up her spot as Prince Gil's fiancee to Isabella and decides to work hard to reform the Hinterland as its new lord. But fate's guillotine doesn't leave Ella's throat, with the blades of many trials to come threatening to stab her. Can she escape her destined death and obtain happiness...?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: I Refuse to be Executed a Second Time

155674.description:
The girl I totally hated has come back way cuter than before…!? Average, ordinary boy Kakeru Komiyama (5th grade) can’t stand his classmate Ena Komiyama. Even though they share the same last name, she excels at both academics and sports, everything he isn’t and it drives him crazy. One day, Ena suddenly transfers to another school, and Kakeru thinks good riddance… but four years later, they reunite at their high school entrance ceremony…!? A childhood friend love story that will make you swoon 200%!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Thrust into the battlefield are average aimless teenager Yosuke Suga and his childhood friend Miyako, who was chasing her dreams of becoming an idol. Can Yosuke fend off his fellow losers and protect Miyako’s future as an idol?

Work life and personal life should be kept separate, but you just can’t deny charisma! Especially when it’s exuding from a competent and amazing boss! But what happens when the confident CEO is actually extremely timid…? And his secretary is always comforting him in clandestine ways…

155685.description:
I have a childhood friend who's just missed his first lecture. Top Student Jang Sian. He's never missed a class, and he's never gotten anything lower than an A+. Although my grades are not comparable to his, we've been friends ever since we met in middle school. We've stuck together since then and now, even in college, we're inseparable. It's because of this that I thought that even if we showed a new side of ourselves to one another, we'd be able to move on from it without a hitch. However... Who knew that there would come a day when I would be fingering his asshole...?!

Chao Yu is the new guy in his school who always fantasizes about a magical world and being a hero. He's close with the prim and proper class representative Nan Mochuan who puts up with his silliness. As Chao Yu becomes closer with Nan Mochuan, will something more evolve between them?

(Source: INKR)

155687.description:
It was love at first sight for high school student Jaemin when he saw Sooji. After confessing to Sooji, they started dating, but the problem is, Sooji ignores Jaemin and games all day. For their three year anniversary, Jaemin wants to do this(?) and that(!) with Sooji, so he suggests Sooji a game... a game where you earn points to win a prize; a prize where you can ask the opponent to grant you a wish! Will Jaemin be able to have the lovey dovey relationship he desires with his gaming addict boyfriend?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

I'm Seo Ju-Yeong, 27, unemployed. I live like the trash of all trash, only troubling others... But right now, I have nothing to do. Because I was tricked by those who said I could earn easy money. Sang-Hyeon is a recessive alpha who is the head of a chaebol family. The dominant alpha Tae-Won has always been attached to him like a shadow, distrusting those around him. Sang-Hyeon had always taken Tae-Won for granted, but after learning that Tae-Won has been using him, he tries to escape from the one who has been abusing his body...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

In the year 2018, a multiplayer survival shooting game became very popular, with over 50 million players at any given moment.

Within this game is a player... "King". The man, the myth, the legend. Unrivaled and undefeated!!

Legend has it that Ji Yu was a genius suffering from hypermnesia. Those with this condition can remember every detail of their lives from something as significant as the world’s turning point to something as small and as insignificant as a minor fleeting thought. In addition, it was said that he was especially beautiful. As soon as the news that he was going to support Tianqiong’s seventh squad broke out, it sent everyone buzzing.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An idiot who doesn’t understand feelings and is a talented killer x A schemer who endured hardships and is in a vegetative state

Maybe it was due to the stimulation of your nerves, you miraculously woke up. You’re unable to leave the bed as your muscles have shrunk, your speech system is on the brink of breaking down — how are you going to escape?

A corrupt school life under surveillance. The antithesis of utopia. An enormous living device. The canal of culture. A magnificent adventure. A destructive weapon. A sanctuary. An ego gone wild, enlarging to the extreme limit, breaking through the boundary between dreams and reality, materializes as the dichotomy between all forms. Embedded into this wild and absurd tale born from the balance of excess and deficiency is only one impulse: "Tell everything."

"Kill yourself, kill the world, pour it all down a gaping hole."

"Selfishly live beautifully, even if it brings your destruction."

155703.description:
Humanity's greatest gym rat Hansol, lost consciousness during a deadlift. When he opened his eyes, he arrived at a different world. Monsters appeared in front of him, and all that he could see was protein...? "I'll flip this world by working out!"

155705.description:
Yukimi Kobayashi spends most of her time alone, but that isn't the strangest thing about her. Yukimi is actually an experimental android that has been placed in school to allow her to develop like a normal child. However, Yukimi didn't always spend her time avoiding people; she used to have many friends. What are the secrets behind Yukimi and why has her personality changed so much? Perhaps the only person who can help her is her teacher.

(Source: Manga Club)

155707.description:
Midori is a first-year junior high school student who has been holding a cue at her grandfather's billiard parlor "Tamadoraku" in Kyoto since she was a child. 155712.description:
September 11, 197x, In the whole Kantou region a magnitude 8-9 violent earthquake occurred. Scholars called it the great destruction of the Showa Era, but the people called it the earthquake from hell! Volcanoes erupted, buildings crumbled, Tokyo became decimated in a single day. The government, after failing to recover the city, abandons Tokyo and moves the capital. The survivors form a society with no laws. In this harsh lawless world emerges Jack, a 10 foot giant who annihilates anyone and anything in his path. The manga details his journey.

Note: This was the serialization in the magazine Weekly Manga Goraku.

155713.description:
Not long after Ougai Mori takes the reins of the Port Mafia, his accomplice Osamu Dazai has a dreadful run in with Chuuya Nakahara, a boy known as the Sheep King who is capable of manipulating gravity. But when strange rumors about the mysterious being Arahabaki start spreading throughout Yokohoma, the duo must put aside their differences and get to the bottom of things. Before they achieved infamy as the fearsome pairing Twin Dark, Dazai and Chuuya were just boys. Was their first encounter a harbinger of hope, or an ill omen of things to come...?

Fairy Teacher Xing Li is on a mission to seal an evil relic when he falls into the Mortal Realm and loses his memory. Nuo Qing, his self-proclaimed disciple, takes him home. But only when an old friend visits does Xing Li realize that Nuo Qing has been waiting hundreds of years for him?

Within the ruins of 24th-century Tokyo, synthesized sustenance and cyber-drugs runs rampant as gangs roam the streets. But even so, humans still desire some good food. Tired after a long day of fighting? Welcome to the Restaurant of Miracles, Garandou!
In the kitchen we have Uka, a young-looking girl with the nickname "Gourmet Museum", working away with an angelic smile; while our waitress-slash-huntress Lyco intimidates any would-be troublemakers with her scary expression.
The two are always looking for new and unknown ingredients, going on chaotic adventures every day in search of anything and everything that could bring about full stomachs and satisfied smiles. From man-eating dragons, lethal mushrooms that kills within seconds, even abandoned battle drones? That's right, anything can be turned into the next mouth-watering dish, so relax and enjoy your meal!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

【Clingy Tsundere School Bully Who Always Blows His Own Horn (but is secretly cute) X Cold, Obsessive, Possessive Top Student】

Yu Yang: I treated you like my mortal enemy, but you want me?

When the two school districts merged, their long-distance online relationship became a next-door classroom situation. Yu Yang would head to the restroom as soon as class ended, pretending to casually pass by his boyfriend's classroom window next door.

The Thousand-Eyed Carp, a monster that lives forever, has a desire to leave this world. However in her attempts to do so, she keeps getting saved again and again by humans. Because of the acts of kindness displayed by humans, she gradually dispells this idea, fully integrating into the human society.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Since entering university, Izumi has been approached by strangers on campus. It seems like there's another 'Izumi' who wears glasses just like him, and he recklessly takes on other people's requests. She and her partner, Sora Tamamori, who possesses strong spiritual powers, team up to investigate a haunted property. But when an evil spirit attacks, the two found themselves in big trouble!

"I don't want to hurt you."

They were supposed to be fighting evil spirits. Instead, she was pinned down by Sora as he gazed at her passionately, while bewildering sensations of pleasure courses through her body… The responsible Mai Shindou and the kind-hearted Sora Tamamori must put their bodies (sexually) on the line to protect the peace of their neighborhood!

There are seven young brothers and sisters who grow up peacefully supported by the love and care of their parents. As a token of gratitude, the children present a trip to the couple on their wedding anniversary. This heartfelt deed, however, causes a terrible misfortune as their parents are killed while on their travels. Though it is certainly a shocking tragedy to the youngsters, they cannot be left in sorrow for a long time. Rather they have to make efforts to stand on their own feet in a body without depending on anybody else. So, their strenuous and daring living starts anew helping one another with brotherly affection, and their sincere attitude and lively activities gradually win admiration and encouragement from people of the community.

(Source: Wikipedia)

155867.description:
Merman Ye Ming falls in love at first sight with the handsome human Lu Chuan while performing at the aquarium. After receiving help from Lu Chuan, his feelings grow stronger, and in the blink of an eye he brings him home with him. The next day he suddenly reveals that he's a merman?!

On his way, he happens to meet Makoto who works at a dog cafe owned by his parents. He sees Makoto give a dog so much affection, he wishes he could get it, too.

After spending some time with Makoto, Hiyori knows for sure he's the one for him and resolves to get closer. But, the next day, a new student teacher comes to school, and guess who it is...!!

(Source: Renta!)

155869.description:
The excellent part-timer Yamasono seems to hate Endou since he, for some reason, avoids Endou and never talks to him. Determined not to let an excellent employee go, Endou tells Yamasono "I like you (because you never leave open shifts)". At a drinking party, and then gets attacked at an unpopular parking structure, on top of that, Yamasono claims "We have the same feelings for each other", an odd misunderstanding, and starts to pursue Endou!

The love tactics of an excellent part-timer with wild assumptions and an around thirty employee who is very serious about his job!

One day, a mysterious force drags the loner high school student Choi Su-A into a romance comic that he liked. And the person that he meets in this unknown yet familiar place is... his favorite character, the male lead Jeong Ji-Hun?!

A slice-of-life drama of the inexperienced nerd Su-A growing up as he goes through ups and downs with his comic friends.

Having a small dick is the only inferiority complex for Do-Won, who is perfect in his wealth, appearance, and personality . Dowon finds out that the sports nerd Cheol-Bong, whom he met at a meet up, has a thick and large penis, he proceeds to have a one-night stand with him...

She is just a child, yet she acts more mature than most adults.
A dramatic story woven between a professional child actress and her manager!

(Source: Comic Fuz, translated)

Yuichi Nekota just entered the huge city-sized school "Eucalyptus Leaf Academy". Excited about his new life, he meets Chitose Arikasaki, a girl who wants to investigate the mysteries of the school! The two form the "After School Secret Club," as they continue their search for the truth!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

155874.description:
They're not anyone's “favorite” foods, but they all have their own place in our hearts. Boiled chikuwabu cakes, sweet amashoku buns, kanpyou (dried gourd!), deep-fried chikuwa fish cakes wrapped in seaweed, sweet suama mochi cakes, soft gyuuhi mochi, frozen mikan, soba water… This manga is an ode to those foods that are a bit unremarkable, yet still so dear to us. The author's cute sidekick Mogu-san is a cute treat as well! Eiko Matsumoto, the creator of Nazo no Ano Mise, brings you this super tasty essay comic that cooks up both laughs and feels.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

The tyranny of the Empire has lasted a thousand years, and true martial arts is but a thing of the past. However, there are still heroes in the most unlikely of places— amongst the motley band of soldiers and outlaws who left the old continent for the New World. One such vigilante, the lone wanderer Janggeon, has the hope of restoring martial arts to its former glory… but is that such an easy thing as it seems?

So Cheon-Ho returns to his homeland after a decade of war and learns that his father has passed away and his disciple-brother, who was no different from his family, had disappeared without a trace!

He briefly spends pleasant days with his childhood friend, So-Hyae, but is entrusted with her daughter, Hui-Yeon before she dies of a disease. Cheon-Ho, who has lost everything, starts an endless war against the Martial Artists in order to protect Hui-Yeon…

The story is set in the Mukojima neighborhood of Tokyo-shitamachi. On nights when you want to have a drink with some friendly folks, how about a warm cup of sake at Sakanatei? The restaurant is run by Ayana, a young proprietress born and raised in Tokyo-shitamachi, and who is quite a gourmand herself. Working alongside her is Iwao-chan, a burly but quiet chef who is a master of seafood preparation. The regulars at the restaurant have been quietly watching over their slightly awkward relationship, until a young newcomer came in and begins to make some brash comments.......?

Seeing her grinning face, the students realized… This girl is dangerous.

Now, their ordinary school life is over, as everyone's darkest secrets become exposed.

Now that the party’s penultimate goal met, the porter, Liddie, decides to follow his dream of becoming an adventurer! While his battle-related skills are close to none, he’s blissfully unaware of just how strong he actually is!

Garyo Hanagami is a best-selling manga artist praised as a genius of the craft. Shinobu Miyama is a bitter rookie with a knack for copying other people's art styles. When an accident causes the two to switch bodies, Miyama is more than happy to take Hanagami's place, forcing the veteran to rebuild his career from the ground up. Now, the dragon must reclaim his throne from the chameleon who replaced him!

Crop-killing diseases have caused great human suffering in the past. The struggle against plant diseases is a part of human history. A young editor, who faints with anything scary, ends up being in charge of the mysterious novelist Sharakuna! The elusive author claims he is in a slump and needs an actual "horror experience" to finish his manuscript. He convinces the editor to join him in visiting many haunted hotspots.

155943.description:
In a world of people evolved from cats, where both males and females can have children... My cute, sweet Noris has adored me ever since he was little. As kids, we even promised to get married. I decided to become a chef to feed him delicious foods and make him happy forever. He's the love of my life... But one day, I see him smiling at some guy I don't know. I thought that smile was only for me...!! All this bottled-up stress and jealousy is making me lose control of my pheromones...

(Source: Renta!)

"People become ugly when they're in love."

Those are the feelings both Yeon-Ji and her closest friend Mu-Re shared when it came to romance. Despite that, Yeonji risks their friendship by asking out Mu-Re before being brutally rejected. Cursing her former friend's name, she wakes up the next day with the ability to read a person's romantic feelings as though she were in a dating sim!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

155947.description: SSSS.GRIDMAN NOVELIZATIONS is a 2-volume spin-off novel series based on SSSS.GRIDMAN. The story takes place some time after episode 8 of the series.

155949.description:
"You're so skinny, you look like one of my girl friends..." Rejected by the girl he likes, Yuto, at the recommendation of a friend, goes to the gym. There, he meets a hot personal trainer, Kyoya. In the middle of a personal training session, the sexy Kyouya plays with Yuto's chest, and Yuto's body temperature shoots up as the two come within kissing distance...! On top of that, he gets a boner, for some reason...! Kyouya, meanwhile, sits in bed thinking about how to win over the cute, but straight, Yuto... Thus begins the start of an intimate love training session between a straight college student and his gym trainer!

(Source: Renta!)
