155950.description:
Sang-u, an average sophomore in college, always dreamt of having multiple versions of himself—one for study, another for play. One day, he awakens with a skill called “cloning,” and Sang-u thinks his dream has come true. But will cloning really steer his life in the direction he had hoped for, or does fate have other plans in store?

(Source: WEBTOON)

155951.description:
His suit pants are filled with love to the point of bursting! Maiko Hanai is the type that just can't say no. She's never stood up to her parents and has always ended up doing whatever her co-workers and friends tell her to do. She's always been passive in her relationships and has never truly fallen in love before.

Just as she thought she'd go on living like this forever, she gets into an accident on the roadside and thinks it was all over for her...! Or so she thought, when she suddenly feels a gust of wind! "Are you alright?" She was saved by a masked gentleman!? His double-breasted suit was bursting with raw muscle. What a sexy body... it was the first time she felt her heart race like this...! Her entire body tingled from his kisses from behind the mask. Now her body won't stop aching!

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: I Feel Like I'm Going to Burst (Under My Suit) With Love!

title.english: So Cute My Suit Pants Are Gonna Burst!
title.native: 愛くるしくて（スーツの下が）はち切れそう！

155952.description:
Yonezawa is a gay man who used to work at a black company.

I'm getting a fresh start and having sex for the first time?!
I picked up a hot guy at a cruising spot!

(Source: Fusion, translated)

Note: A "black company" overworks and exploits its employees through unpaid overtime.
synonyms: When I Quit Being a Corporate Slave

title.native: 僕が社畜をやめてから

155953.description:
Tyrant turned toddler!

After realizing she's inside her favorite novel, Ellenfiela uses her "prophetic powers," a.k.a. her knowledge of the story, to make money! This catches the eye of the imperial palace, and she's recruited to help the emperor, who has an unusual problem. But this wasn't in the original novel, was it?!

(Source: Manta)

155954.description:
This marriage was business. It was not a combination of Cha Gang-Hyeok and Yu Eun-Seo, but a combination of Samwoo Shipbuilding and Yuseong Heavy Industries. There was no erotic desire for an arranged marriage for the sake of the soul. But one day...

My husband, who was only cold, turned into a beast.

“I didn’t know you were such a lewd woman. If you need a man, tell me sooner rather than later. I would have been happy to embrace you.”

The ingrained voice, crack by excitement, contained a strong desire for Eun-Seo. A destructive and wild desire to have her wildly, roughly, and violently.

(Source: Naver, translated)

155955.description:
Would you eat your adorable, talking pet vegetable?

Is the argument over what’s right or wrong to eat a matter of ethics or a difference in undertanding? Ihae, a children’s story writer and vegetarian, begins each day by eating the leaf of his pet vegetable, “Aechae.” But one day, an unpleasant surprise comes his way, suddenly hurling him into a crisis...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes two prologues.

155957.description:
With a warm family that showered her with love, Iyanelle’s life was a bed of roses. That is, until the day she found herself bleeding out on the ground beside her dead father. The culprit? Her beloved brother, Crown Prince Agris de Roahim. Heartbroken and betrayed, Iyanelle could only accept her impending death. However, it seems fate has other plans for her… Next thing she knows, she’s been reborn as a divine fox! In her new form, will she be able to bring her ex-brother’s conspiracy to light?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated as a Baby Fox God
ฉันเกิดใหม่เป็นลูกสัตว์เทพ

155958.description:
Yu-Jeong Seo is a hardworking tattooist who loves nothing more than to eat good food while reading her favorite novel during her downtime. One particular day, she is doing exactly that when she suddenly hears a strange voice coming from outside her apartment. She steps out to see what’s going on but loses her footing and falls down a flight of stairs. When she regains consciousness, she finds herself in a whole new world and in the body of someone completely different. As it turns out, a fairy, who was dimension traveling, was responsible for Yu-Jeong’s accident and revived her as a botanical sorcerer out of guilt. Yu-Jeong adapts quickly and names herself “Sylvia Arbor” to fit in and avoid any suspicion. But soon, “Sylvia” learns that she had in fact been revived in the world of the novel she was reading right before she died; and in this novel, the main character, Felix, suffers from ageusia as a result of years of abuse by his stepmother. Will Sylvia’s love of food and ability to use magic be Felix’s salvation...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

155959.description:
Souta is in love with his kind and handsome boyfriend, Yoichi. And they're living together! Souta thought they could be in love forever, but it seems like Yoichi has been hiding something lately?! When he started to worry about, he saw a suspicious email...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: カン違いラブファクトリー

155960.description:
After her divorced parents remarry, Yui returns to her hometown for the first time in eight years. She has not seen her older brother, Hayato, during that time, so she is amazed to see how popular and grown-up he has become. She also bumps into her childhood friend, Ritsu, who she remembers as a crybaby, and almost doesn't recognize him. Now living with her brother again, she can't help but notice her heart fluttering with each interaction. Does this mean she might like him?! Knowing how taboo these thoughts are, Ritsu suggests he and Yui date as a way to nip her feelings for Hayato in the bud. Yet this family tree may not actually be as simple as it seems…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter and one side story of Amakunai Karera no Nichijou wa. (Those Not-So-Sweet Boys).
synonyms: Our love is not that simple.

title.native: 僕らの好きはわりきれない
title.romaji: Bokura no Suki wa Wari Kirenai

155961.description:
9-page short story of a man's encounter on his travels to Hokkaido.

Note: Published in Jiyuu Jikan No. 94, it was later on released in Tokyo Genshiki and in The Walking Man Deluxe Edition

155962.description:
It's just Ara's luck to be hit by a car and reborn in a novel as the villainous "Meliara." To make things worse, she knows that the empire in this novel is about to get destroyed by the world's Demon King in a few months, so she must make a quick escape to the far corners of the empire while she can. She just can't catch a break! But as she's leaving, she runs into the dashing and mysterious Rehett, who, for some reason, immediately offers to accompany her on her journey as her bodyguard. What's stranger is that Rehett seems to know an awful lot about Meliara's tastes and preferences from her past life, despite meeting her for the first time. How could this be? Though she doesn't know it yet, Meliara's past and current lives are inextricably intertwined for a higher purpose beyond her imagination.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I Became a Villainess in a Deadly Novel
I Became the Villainess in an Anticlimactic Novel
Réincarnée en vilaine d'un roman tragique

title.english: I Became the Villainess in a Disastrous Novel

155964.description: True love conquers all. Or at least, that is what Tessa would like to believe. Growing up stuck in an orphanage with her lover, Hert, she would do anything to give the two of them a better life. So when she is presented with a contract that would place them in servitude of the Marquis de Juttert - she as a maid, and he as a squire - she jumps at the chance. But reality hits when the true nature of the contract is revealed: Tessa is now doomed to become the Marquis’s sixth wife, and Hert a gladiator faced with certain death. But years later, when the Marquis is overthrown by a vengeful Hert, the knight has only one question for the sorrowful Tessa: “Why did you betray me?”

155965.description:
The evil enemies of the Holy Empire of Cairon must be purged. With the superhuman Nox of Yipon already dealt with, the only ones left to destroy are the Witches of Tempey. After a long search, Cairon’s greatest protector, Sir Macklart, finally tracks down their leader, the infamous Grand Witch called Vienie. They say just one look into her bloodred eyes will immediately entrap you into her wicked spell. Though Sir Macklart brushes it off as nonsense, perhaps there is something mysterious behind Vienie’s crimson stare, as he certainly can’t seem to read the witch’s intentions when she suddenly offers to help him eradicate her own kind…

(Source: Tappytoon)

155966.description:
Da-Im, who was bullied by bullies chanced upon a game that was in his old phone that would change his life. An unbalanced strategy RPG game where one grows by ordering bullies to do things and recruiting kind people! The ultimate goal of this RPG game is to eliminate school violence from the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

155967.description:
A cosmic anomaly has opened interdimensional breaches on Earth, creating exotic hybrid environments called “dungeons” inhabited by deadly otherworldly creatures. Yoo Jaryong, left to fend for himself as his father’s health deteriorates, secretly cultivates the superhuman potential arising from the anomaly and becomes a dungeon smuggler to pay his bills. When elite dungeon raiders discover his skills, he is given the chance to train at the alma mater of the world’s heroes: Yongsa High School.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Warrior High School - Dungeon Raid Department

155968.description:
The God who rules over the vast world of 'Rodowan' one day announces a new Divine Law: All reproduction is immediately prohibited.

Those who are banned from conceiving rebel for the sake of humankind and their children, but the power of God and their followers is overwhelming and oppressive.

God brands children born after the Divine Law as children of traitors, killing them or turning them into slaves.

In this chaotic world, those who wish to punish this sick tyranny begin their desperate fight.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

155969.description:
Yamato is a well-known playboy around the campus. Whether it be man or woman, as long as he's had his fill of sex, he's satisfied. When a supposed sex encounter leads him to meet the aloof Hodaka, who appears unaffected by him, Yamato can't help but be curious about the latter and how they are at sex. Yamato then starts to hang around Hodaka and seduce him, but it turns out that Hodaka isn't that easy. He's more than what Yamato had expected. And it seems there's more to Hodaka than what meets the eye.

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

155970.description:
“A hero who fights powerful enemies to save the world."

Highschool student Katsuri Kobayashi longs to be the protagonist of a game world like that. One day, however, “the real world = a crappy game” receives an update, and his everyday life is thrown into chaos!

From Weekly Young Jump, the magazine that has produced many legendary sci-fi battle manga, comes a classic, straight-up sci-fi action series!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

155974.description:
I, Hiro Bouchi, was ostracized by the entire school because I stood up against the student who held an absolute power in the school. But no matter what kind of bullying I received every day, I never yielded. Today as well, I was getting beaten up behind the school building. But at that moment, I heard the students screaming―That was the moment when the world was transformed.

On the school grounds, the students were being attacked and killed one after another by monsters that seemed to have come out from an RPG. Using this opportunity, I managed to escape and return home safely. Then at that time, I realized that I had a strange power dwelling inside me. A skill called "Shop."

As long as I could pay for it, I have the ability to buy variety of items on Earth, and even fantasy items that couldn't possibly exist on Earth. In this world, where humans were gradually being wiped out, I decided to make the most of my new skill to live a slow, comfortable life free of worries.

It was truly thrilling and delightful to see all the people whom hated and ostracized me being killed one after another because they didn't have the power I did. This is the payback story of a boy who was once bullied, and uses his skill to take advantage of those who are now left with nothing.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: "SHOPSKILL" Sae Areba, Dungeon ka Sita Sekaidemo Rakusyou da: Hakugai Sareta Shounen no Saikyou Zamaa Life
As Long as I Have the [Shop] Skill, I'll Have an Easy Life Even in a World That Has Been Transformed Into a Dungeon!

155975.description:
Ochiai, a salaryman working at a black company, is on his way home, on the verge of mental breakdown. He wants to die. But he doesn't want to die hungry! He passes by a ramen cart run by a young girl named Keira, with the sign "Shinigami Ramen." Keira calls herself a "Shinigami" (god of death) and offers Ochiai a bowl of ramen that's so good that it will allow him to die in peace if he eats it. Will he be able to enjoy the ramen and pass on, or not? Even if he doesn't die, the cute loli-reaper will give him hope for life!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

155976.description:
Missions, mixers, and midnight snack runs-there's never a slow day at Café LycoReco! Find out what's new on the menu for Chisato, Takina, and company in this official comic anthology!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: リコリス・リコイル 公式コミックアンソロジー リロード
title.romaji: Lycoris Recoil Koushiki Comic Anthology: Reload

155977.description: Midori is fascinated by Yukiko's comb, a keepsake from her deceased big sister, because it makes a beautiful song each time she runs the comb through her hair with it. Without thinking about it, Midori ends up stealing the comb. But then, a lot of her hair fall each time she uses the comb!

155978.description:
I, Hiri Yasaka, serve Minakata-sama, the "Guardian God of the Village," as a shrine maiden!
Minakata-sama is always kind and wonderful, and even though I have a crush for him, just being by his side like this is enough to make me happy...

That's what I thought, until today!

It seems that Minakata-sama's power is weakening, and the only way to restore it is to have sex with me, the miko! Even though it was for the sake of Minakata-sama, as he kissed me and gently laid me down.... I couldn't stop my heart from pounding with excitement at the sight of his sweet face and his strong chest beneath his kimono. But then Minakata-sama made me an "unexpected proposal"...!

This is the start of a slightly mysterious and heart-warming love story between a God x Miko!

(Source: Kanon Comics, translated)

title.native: 嬌声乱舞 いとしの神様は甘やかに雄でした
title.romaji: Kyousei Ranbu: Itoshi no Kamisama wa Amaya ka ni Osudeshita

155979.description:
He's a cool guy and the perfect gentleman, and I'm going to marry him! But we still haven't "done it" yet…! On our honeymoon, we're finally going to have our first time together. I was so thrilled when he revealed his unexpected sexual fetish to me. The story of a newlywed wife who is doted on by a slightly perverted husband full of unexpected surprises.

(Source: Choco Love, translated)

155981.description:
Yukana Asakino is a part-time music teacher. She has both beauty and saint-like kindness. She's the perfect woman, respected by students and teachers alike... however... She has a secret that no one knows. The only one impervious to her charm is Koki Nagami, one of her students. He's standoffish and always treats Miss Asakino coldly. However, he also has a secret he's been keeping from everybody...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ふしだらな恋のエチュード～先生、俺の初めて叶えてくれる？～

155983.description:
Han Seung-Hui and Jeon Jin-Seok, the fantastic duo that created "One Thousand and One Nights", are back together!

A masterpiece manhwa depicting the dramatic life of Im Chun-Aeng, a genius artist and the founder of Yeoseong Gukgeuk (The Women's National Performance Group), which dominated an era!!

(Source: Manyeo Comics)

Note:
- This is a fictional account of the life of Im Chun-Aeng, a real musician, actress, and choreographer
- Won the 2006 Today's Manhwa Award (오늘의 우리만화상)

155984.description:
Mako falls ill on a date with her boyfriend, who takes her to a nearby clinic. But Mako was not prepared for how "thorough" her check-up was going to be!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (MIMK-108) was released on November 15th, 2022.

155989.description:
Gigi finds Kang Do-Hyeon, the reincarnation of Vivica, the woman he loved, and becomes his roommate. The woman he loved has turned into a cold man, and to make matters worse, the passage to another world is getting narrower because of the power he used...

(Source: Naver, translated)

155991.description:
A special hotel in a secluded region of Rio. Warm and moving stories created by the people who live there and those who have passed through it . People come to the hotel with worries — the first book that collects their sweet, human stories.

(Source: Sigongsa, translated)
